messages:
Mira: Heads-up — over the last 3 hours we've seen spot interruption events spike in us-west2, but CPU utilization didn't drop proportionally. Interruptions look noisy/partial.
Raj: Noted. Is this the same pattern as last month where the provider sent spurious SIGNAL flips? :thinking_face:
Mira: Seems similar but different cadence. I pulled the raw instance-level signals: a lot of short-lived preemption warnings (~20–40s) and then cancel. Our current alert treats any preempt warn >0 as an incident.
Kai: Oof. That will blow up PagerDuty for transient flaps. We should debounce or use a composite metric.
Olivia: Agree. Proposed composite: interruption_rate_1m * (1 - capacity_fraction_1m) + eviction_count_5m. That would downweight transient single-signal blips.
Devon: Can you paste the PromQL you had in mind? I can add to the dashboard and alert rule.
Mira: Sure — rough draft:

```
# fraction of machines seeing a preempt warning in last minute
preempt_frac = sum by(zone) (increase(cloud_preempt_warning_total[1m])) / sum by(zone) (machine_count)
# short-lived cancels
short_cancel = increase(cloud_preempt_cancel_total[5m])
# composite score
composite_score = preempt_frac * (1 - avg_over_time(gpu_capacity_fraction[1m])) + short_cancel / max(1, sum(machine_count))
```

Mira: For alerts: trigger only if composite_score > 0.15 for 5m AND request_p95_latency_increase > 10%.
Raj: Adding a latency condition is key — avoid paging when user-visible SLOs unaffected.
Kai: For the dashboard, add a small heatmap: zone x instance-type with color = composite_score. Also include a sparklines column for preempt_frac and cancel_rate.
Olivia: I'll wire that up in Grafana. Which dashboard folder? infra/spot-ops? Or new one?
Devon: New folder infra/spot-watchdog — keep older dashboards intact.
sre-bot: Incident prediction model run completed. Next run scheduled in 10m. :robot_face:
Mira: One more thing — we should record the duration distribution of warnings. If >60% of warnings are <1m, treat as ephemeral and suppress PD.
Raj: Implementation plan:
1) Update PromQL and dashboard (Olivia)
2) Change alert rule to use composite_score + latency (Kai)
3) Add suppression logic for short warnings in alerting engine (Devon)
4) Run a 48h canary and measure false positive rate (Mira/Raj)

Kai: I'll propose new thresholds in the alert PR after we see the canary results. :thumbsup:
Olivia: Deployed dashboard draft to infra/spot-watchdog/draft — link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/spot-watchdog
Mira: Thanks all. If we still get noisy PDs after the canary, next step is to add a temporary auto-backoff window per zone.
Devon: I'll add a note in runbook under incidents/spot-preempt that explains the composite metric and suppression logic.
Raj: Sounds good. Closing loop: status update in 24h here. :eyes:
